What does the patch do?

Original-quality mode reorganizes the container without re-encoding. Custom export changes FPS, dimensions, quality or bitrate using a local H.264 encoder. The aspect ratio is preserved without cropping. Exports above the source frame rate repeat frames. TikTok may reprocess uploads; playback quality is not guaranteed.
